2.title: Sean Grayson, Ex-Illinois Deputy Who Murdered Sonya Massey, Dies in Prison
2.summary: Sean Grayson, 32, was serving a 20-year sentence for the 2024 murder of Sonya Massey, who was holding a pot of hot water when she was shot at her home.

3.title: What You Should Know About College Admissions Changes

5.title: Can ‘Argentina’s Texas’ Save the Country’s Economy?
5.summary: Thousands of Argentines are flocking to a remote stretch of Patagonia, seeking work with only backpacks, tents and the hope that they and their country can turn around their fortunes.

6.title: Man Who Told of a Childhood With Wolves Dies at 80
6.summary: The improbable story of Marcos Rodríguez Pantoja’s wild youth became the subject of a study, as well as inspiring a novel and a film.
